description: This file contains the Hibernate configuration for a Spring-based Java application. It sets up the DataSource, Hibernate SessionFactory, and TransactionManager, using properties loaded from an external file.

classes.name: HibernateConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines beans for Hibernate session factory, data source, and transaction manager.

methods.name: getSessionFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures Hibernate SessionFactory based on the provided DataSource.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Configures and returns the DataSource bean using environment properties.

methods.name: getHibernateProperties
methods.description: Assembles Hibernate-specific properties from environment variables.

methods.name: getTransactionManager
methods.description: Creates a HibernateTransactionManager with the given SessionFactory.
